audit_scope: Security audit and compliance scanning for production systems

dependency_audit.recommendation: All dependencies are up-to-date with no known vulnerabilities

code_security_findings.title: Weak API Key Hashing
code_security_findings.description: The hashApiKey function uses a simple hash algorithm for API key storage. The code explicitly notes this is for demo purposes only.
code_security_findings.code_snippet: function hashApiKey(key) { let hash = 0; for (let i = 0; i < key.length; i++) { const char = key.charCodeAt(i); hash = ((hash << 5) - hash) + char; hash = hash & hash; } return `hash_${Math.abs(hash).toString(16)}`; }
code_security_findings.recommendation: Replace with bcrypt or argon2 for production API key hashing. The comment at line 309 already acknowledges this requirement.

code_security_findings.title: Password Reset Token Exposed in Response
code_security_findings.description: The password reset endpoint returns the reset token directly in the API response. In production, this should only be sent via secure email.
code_security_findings.code_snippet: res.json({ success: true, message: 'Password reset initiated', data: { reset_token: resetToken, expires_at: resetExpiry } });
code_security_findings.recommendation: Remove reset_token from API response. Send token via secure email only. Add rate limiting to prevent abuse.

code_security_findings.title: Missing Authentication Middleware
code_security_findings.description: User management routes lack authentication middleware. The /api/users/me endpoint requires user_id as query parameter instead of proper authentication.
code_security_findings.recommendation: Implement JWT or session-based authentication middleware. Use req.user from authentication context instead of query parameters.

code_security_findings.title: Session Tokens Not Cryptographically Secure
code_security_findings.description: Session IDs are generated using Math.random() which is not cryptographically secure.
code_security_findings.recommendation: Use crypto.randomBytes() or uuid v4 for session ID generation.

code_security_findings.title: No Role-Based Access Control Enforcement
code_security_findings.description: While roles and permissions are defined, there's no middleware enforcing them on routes. Any user can access any endpoint.
code_security_findings.recommendation: Implement authorization middleware that checks user permissions before allowing access to sensitive operations like user management.

positive_findings.title: Proper Input Validation
positive_findings.description: Comprehensive input validation using express-validator with strict patterns for usernames, emails, IDs, and other fields.

positive_findings.title: Parameterized SQL Queries
positive_findings.description: Database queries use parameterized statements to prevent SQL injection attacks.

positive_findings.title: No eval() or Function() Usage
positive_findings.description: No dangerous dynamic code execution patterns found in production code.

positive_findings.title: Secure Environment Variable Handling
positive_findings.description: No .env files committed to repository. Sensitive data properly excluded from version control.

positive_findings.title: Activity Logging
positive_findings.description: Comprehensive activity logging for audit trails on user actions.

positive_findings.title: Proper Error Handling
